content:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to let you know that I’m retiring from Harvard, and this will be my last week with the Dataverse project.

It’s been a pleasure getting to know some of you through community meetings, working groups, and conferences, and I’m very glad to have had the opportunity to be part of this community.

Thank you, and I wish you all the very best!

Ellen
All the best Ellen! Thank you for all your great work on this project and for the community, I really appreciate it! As Udo Jürgens would have it: "Mit 60 Jahren fängt das Leben an!" :wink:
